title: Your first run: what to expect
target: What a R.E.P.O. run actually contains, in the order you meet it, based only on behaviour the game's own files establish.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A fresh run, solo or with a crew
A level you can walk around

steps.do: Treat every monster as a different problem rather than one enemy type.
steps.because: the game defines several distinct monsters with their own behaviour (EnemyOogly, EnemySlowWalkerAnim, EnemyHeadGrabberAnim)

steps.do: Find the extraction point before you fill your hands.
steps.because: extraction happens at tracked points on the level (ExtractionPoint, ExtractionPointTracking)

steps.do: Bank an extraction before you push deeper into the level.
steps.because: the game records completed extractions, so finishing one is progress (ExtractionsDoneState)

commonMistakes: Dealing with every monster the same way.
Carrying valuables carelessly: they are physics objects whose behaviour the game defines per item.
Pushing deeper without completing an extraction first.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
